modalities.evidence: single-cell images taken from peripheral blood smears

output.population: 100 patients diagnosed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia at Munich University Hospital between 2014 and 2017, and 100 patients without signs of hematological malignancy
output.summary: Expert-labeled single-cell images from peripheral blood smears of patients with acute myeloid leukemia and of patients without hematological malignancy, classified into a standard morphological scheme, with a subset re-annotated to quantify rater variability.
